# Store packages and rank setup

The Tebex packages, their prices and the commands each runs, and the LuckPerms commands that create the ranks. Why each item is priced and allowed is in [store.md](store.md); how to enter them in Tebex is in [store-tebex-checklist.md](store-tebex-checklist.md).

Every command runs with **Require the player to be online** on, so LuckPerms knows the player. Use `{username}` (never `{uuid}`): the store is a Minecraft Offline/Geyser store so Bedrock names work.

## Season pass rewards

Premium track: `monkey.pass.s1.premium`. XP: 100 per weekly challenge done, 20 per day played, 50 per event attended; a tier every 80 XP. Each reward runs one command in the pass plugin.

| Tier | Free track | Premium track |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | - | tag: S1 Pass |
| 2 | - | Projectile Effect: SculkSoul |
| 3 | tag: S1 | Pet: Silverfish |

| 7 | - | tag: Night Raider |

| 9 | tag: Climber | Pet: Vex |
| 10 | - | tag: Monkey Business |
| 11 | - | Projectile Effect: CursedHelix |
| 12 | Projectile Effect: Smoke | Pet: Hoglin |
| 13 | - | tag: Jungle King |
| 14 | - | Particle Effect: VolcanicHalo |

| 16 | - | tag: Apex |
| 17 | - | Projectile Effect: SquidInk |
| 18 | Pet: Tadpole | Pet: Illusioner |
| 19 | - | tag: Untouchable |
| 20 | - | Particle Effect: BloodHelix |

Reward command: `lp user {player} permission set ultracosmetics.pets.vex true` (the cosmetic's node from the tables above; `{player}` is the pass plugin's placeholder).

## LuckPerms setup

Run once on the new server (console, or `python tools/store.py luckperms`):

```
lp creategroup ember
lp group ember setweight 100
lp group ember setdisplayname Ember
lp group ember meta setprefix 100 "<#ff8a3d>[Ember]</#ff8a3d> "
lp group ember permission set ultracosmetics.pets.piggy true
```
